policy: public == manifest public surface — plugin export is subset (not all public tools are plugin-exposed)

tools.description: Unified basin intelligence: profile, resolve, macrostrat, backstrip, mass balance, thermal maturity, map context, deep time, tectonic reconstruction.
tools.name: geox_basin

tools.description: 1D basin backstripping: Steckler & Watts 1978 + Sclater & Christie 1980. Reconstruct tectonic and total subsidence through time.
tools.name: geox_basin_backstrip

tools.description: Unified claim lifecycle: create, validate, challenge, seal, evidence, consequence, optionality, cascade, feedback integrity, truth challenge.
tools.name: geox_claim

tools.description: Scan claims for contradictions using13-type ontology. Classifies severity (FATAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW) and resolution path (VOID/HOLD/DEMOTE/ESCALATE). FATAL →888_HOLD.
tools.name: geox_contradiction_scan

tools.description: Earth State Vector through deep time: GPTS, CO2, sea level, temperature, paleogeography.
tools.name: geox_deep_time_state

tools.description: Unified evidence synthesis: discover, synthesize, abduct, contradict, spatial_block, ingest_literature.
tools.name: geox_evidence

tools.description: Popperian falsification engine — Kill Matrix K001-K007 + contradiction scan. GENESIS/015 architecture: physics must prove the claim is right. ANY KILL → rejected. All PASS → PROCEED to 888_JUDGE.
tools.name: geox_falsify

tools.description: Geomechanical analysis: bulk/shear/young modulus, poisson ratio, acoustic impedance, stress polygon.
tools.name: geox_geomechanics

tools.description: LEM inference — predict rock properties (porosity, Sw, lithology) from well log curves. Physics-prior mode (Archie, Gardner, Wyllie) until federated weights deploy.
tools.name: geox_lem_predict

tools.description: List available map layers and their spatial extents.
tools.name: geox_map_layers_list

tools.description: Render preview of map scene for quality review before export.
tools.name: geox_map_render_preview

tools.description: Plan map scene composition: layer ordering, zoom, and annotation layout.
tools.name: geox_map_scene_plan

tools.description: Unified petrophysics: Vsh, porosity, Sw, permeability, net pay, LEM inference, QC. Modes: generate, verify, lem_inference, stoip_feed, qc.
tools.name: geox_petrophysics

tools.description: Prospect evaluation: volumetrics, POS, EVOI, risk assessment. Modes: screen, evaluate.
tools.name: geox_prospect

tools.description: Seismic computation: forward model, well tie, attributes, wavelet extraction, inversion.
tools.name: geox_seismic_compute

tools.description: SEG-Y I/O, header inspection, export.
tools.name: geox_seismic_ingest

tools.description: One semantic capability — propose geometry, physics-gate, compare hypotheses (NOT autonomous SEAL). Live modes: horizon_contrast, fault_sticks, volume_frame, blend, structure_validate, interpret (interpretation_bundle ≥3 hyps), interpret_section/rsi_pipeline (INT_SEISMIC), segy_slice. Gates return PASS|WARN|KILL|UNMEASURED + receipt_hash. preferred_hypothesis always null from GEOX. Local max QUALIFIED_CANDIDATE — arifOS seals only.
tools.name: geox_seismic_interpret

tools.description: Unified stratigraphy: sequence analysis, biostratigraphic parsing and falsification. Modes: correlation, biostrat_parse, biostrat_falsify.
tools.name: geox_sequence

tools.description: Subsurface model building: joint inversion, gravity/magnetic forward, MT forward.
tools.name: geox_subsurface_model

tools.description: Federation-standard registry probe: tool discovery and health status.
tools.name: geox_surface_status

tools.description: Burial + heat flow + maturity modeling through time. EasyRo + TTI.
tools.name: geox_thermal_maturity_history

tools.description: Extract visual patterns from seismic section images using deep learning.
tools.name: geox_visual_understand

tools.description: Well desk: interactive view, publish rendered panel, render well panel. Modes: open, publish, render.
tools.name: geox_well_desk

tools.description: Load well log data from LAS, SEG-Y, DST, deviation, or tops files. Auto-detects format.
tools.name: geox_well_ingest

tools.description: Quality control for well data: depth monotonicity, null %, physical range checks.
tools.name: geox_well_qc

tools.description: Well Witness View — hydrate real LAS curves into interactive tracks for WellDesk/Well Witness widgets.
tools.name: geox_well_view

tools.description: GEOX Workspace — persistent geological context across all tools. Set basin/play/well once; every tool inherits. Modes: set, view, history, evidence, relations, reset.
tools.name: geox_workspace
